data.one_liner: An Instagram-inspired image and video picker with multi-picking and cropping support.
data.what_it_does: Provides an Instagram-like UI for selecting and cropping multiple images and videos. It handles preview, selection, aspect ratio adjustment, and returns exported asset details with crop parameters.
use_when: You want an Instagram-styled media picker experience in your app.
You need built-in multi-asset picking with custom crop ratios like 1:1 and 4:5.
You want to pick both images and videos using a custom picker delegate.
avoid_when: You need built-in video processing capabilities out-of-the-box.
You need a simple default platform picker instead of a custom themed UI.
strengths: Replicates the smooth UI and scroll behaviors of Instagram's picker.
Supports multiple asset selections and batch cropping.
Highly customizable themes, localizations, and crop aspect ratios.
weaknesses: Video processing is not handled by the package and must be implemented manually.
Requires specific native setup steps and configuration from the underlying wechat assets picker.
data.setup_notes: Requires following the setup instructions of flutter_wechat_assets_picker for platform permissions and configurations.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a simpler, default platform-native image and video picker instead of a custom Instagram-styled UI.
